<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

    <circle cx="332" cy="290" r="5" fill="#FFD469"/>
    <text x="343" y="294" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">USD</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="339" width="166" height="48" rx="24" fill="#3EB3F9"/>

    <text x="327" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#0275BA">Ready</text>

    <text x="350" y="744" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#0275BA">+$25.00</text>

    <!-- Home -->

    <rect x="43" y="805" width="12" height="11" fill="none" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="1.8"/>
